title: C2 Milestone 4: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Magistral! Has completado el cuarto hito de C2. Eres ahora un experto en sortear la política de la alta dirección, manejar crisis de relaciones públicas y usar una sintaxis formal (whom, of which, albeit) que impone respeto absoluto.

parts.visual:
En este cuarto hito de C2 evaluaremos tu dominio de las lecciones 16 a 19: 

1. Advanced Relative Clauses: Whom (objeto formal), Of which (para cosas), Whereby (mediante el cual). 
2. Discourse Markers: Albeit (aunque), Notwithstanding (a pesar de), Conversely (por el contrario), Insofar as (en la medida en que).
parts.audio: In this fourth C2 milestone, we will evaluate your mastery of lessons 16 to 19. We will test Advanced Relative Clauses, such as 'Whom', 'Of which', and 'Whereby'. We will also test Discourse Markers like 'Albeit', 'Notwithstanding', 'Conversely', and 'Insofar as'.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos el vocabulario corporativo avanzado: 

3. Boardroom Politics: C-Suite, Stakeholder, Golden parachute, Glass ceiling, Nepotism, Whistleblower. 
4. Crisis Management: Damage control, Backlash, Scapegoat, Sweep under the rug, PR stunt, Spin doctor. 

¡Demuestra que dominas la retórica y la estrategia del más alto nivel!
parts.audio: We will also review advanced corporate vocabulary. From Boardroom Politics: words like C-Suite, Stakeholder, Golden parachute, Glass ceiling, Nepotism, and Whistleblower. And from Crisis Management: Damage control, Backlash, Scapegoat, Sweep under the rug, PR stunt, and Spin doctor. Show that you master rhetoric and high-level strategy!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio C2 en este examen integral.

questions.question: The CEO, ____ the board completely trusts, has resigned unexpectedly. (A quien).
The proposal was approved, ____ with severe modifications. (Aunque / Si bien).
To avoid a hostile ____, the company implemented a poison pill strategy. (Toma de control hostil).
The PR team is in ____ control mode after the CEO's controversial tweet. (Control de daños).
They received three offers, none of ____ met their financial requirements. (Ninguna de las cuales).
The drop in sales ____, we are still opening the new branch. (A pesar de la caída).
A ____holder is someone who owns shares, while a ____holder is anyone affected by the company.
Instead of admitting the mistake, they tried to sweep it under the ____. (Alfombra).
We signed a contract ____ they agree to supply materials for five years. (Mediante el cual).
The product is cheap to produce; ____, it is very expensive to transport. (Por el contrario).
The fired executive left the company with a $10 million golden ____.
The manager was blamed for the failure, but he was just a ____. (Chivo expiatorio).
The extent ____ which the market crashed was unprecedented.
questions.explanation: The extent TO which = el grado hasta/en el cual.

questions.question: It's a good deal ____ as we don't have to pay upfront. (En la medida en que).
questions.explanation: Insofar as = en la medida en que.

questions.question: The employee who reported the massive tax fraud to the police is known as a ____. (Denunciante).
The announcement caused severe public ____ on social media. (Reacción negativa/Rechazo).
The person ____ whom I negotiated was very tough. (Con quien - formal).
questions.explanation: Negotiate WITH -> The person WITH whom.

questions.question: We lost our main supplier; ____, we cannot meet the deadline. (Por lo tanto).
She finally broke the glass ____ and became the first female CEO. (Techo de cristal).
Don't issue a statement. If we stay quiet, this scandal will eventually ____ over. (Pasar al olvido).
The man ____ I hired. (A quien - formal)
Good, ____ expensive. (Aunque - formal con A)
Hostile ____. (Toma de control hostil)
____ control. (Control de daños)
None of ____. (De las cuales)
The rain ____. (A pesar de - postpuesto con N)
A ____ parachute. (Indemnización millonaria)
A public ____. (Fuerte rechazo público con B)
A PR ____. (Truco publicitario con S)
To ____ over. (Pasar al olvido con B)
